Experience 0 + About Dr. Sandra Reyes Dr. Sandra Reyes is a trusted dentist in Mesa, Arizona, specializing in family, cosmetic, and restorative dentistry. With over 20 years of experience, Dr. Reyes and her team are dedicated to providing high-quality, modern dental care with a strong focus on prevention, patient education, and long-term oral health. They strive to create a welcoming and comfortable environment where patients feel confident, informed, and empowered throughout their dental care journey. The team operates with a strong commitment to honesty, transparency, and patient-centered care. Our philosophy emphasizes ongoing education and staying current with the latest advancements in dentistry to provide the highest quality treatment possible. The Office of Dr. Sandra Reyes proudly serves patients of all ages, including individuals with special needs, while promoting the important connection between oral health and overall wellness. About Us Our Services General Dentistry Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS provides general dentistry services, including exams, cleanings, and preventive care, to maintain optimal oral health for patients of all ages. Learn More Cosmetic Dentistry Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS offers cosmetic dentistry services, including teeth whitening, veneers, and smile makeovers, to enhance the beauty and confidence of your smile. Learn More Restorative Dentistry Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS offers restorative dentistry services, including fillings, crowns, bridges, and implants, to repair and strengthen damaged or missing teeth for a healthier smile. Learn More Orthodontics Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS provides orthodontic treatments, including traditional braces and clear aligners, to help patients achieve a straighter, healthier smile. Learn More Emergency Dentistry Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS offers emergency dentistry services, providing prompt care for dental pain, broken teeth, and urgent oral health issues to restore comfort and function Learn More Why Choose Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS? At Dr. Sandra Reyes, DDS, we believe everyone deserves a healthy, beautiful smile. Our experienced team provides personalized care, from routine checkups to advanced cosmetic and restorative treatments. We prioritize patient comfort, using the latest technology to ensure a stress-free dental experience. Whether you need preventive care or a complete smile makeover, we are here to help. Let us be your trusted partner in achieving optimal oral health. Book Appointment Meet the Team View All Members Testimonials Prior to seeing Dr. Reyes, I had visited another dentist who insisted that I needed at least a couple of root canals and some crowns. I was skeptical and decided to get a second opinion. I am so glad I did. Dr. Reyes listened to my concerns and was thorough in explaining what I needed. She was able to save my tooth from a root canal and no crowns so far. Dr. Reyes truly cares about her patient's health and listens to their concerns and her staff is awesome. Everyone is so kind and helpful that you just feel comfortable during your visit. Raquel B., AZ Our family has been seeing Dr. Reyes for many years, and I can confidently attest to her professional and interpersonal skills. Dr. Reyes is gentle, caring, and honest. During my last consultation for a potential cosmetic procedure she clearly presented me with all the options, while highlighting both the advantages and drawbacks of each, allowing me to make an informed decision rather than trying to persuade me to undergo the procedure. The staff at Dr. Reyes' office (Jen, Luz and Sabrina) are just as amazing, so if you are looking for an exceptional practice, your search can stop here and now. Julieta P., Gilbert, AZ Dr. Reyes is a SUPERB DENTIST ... The facility is very clean and modern. Actually Spotless. After 40 years of neglect on my mouth it was fully explained to me that I would need some major work. The journey to a new smile was very easy, painless, and with minimal discomfort. The entire staff in the office is friendly and caring. They really care about your condition and genuinely have an interest in your progress. I can HIGHLY RECOMMEND Dr. Sandra Reyes for any procedure you may need. My personal experience has been very positive and is an overall improvement on my quality of life. J.L. - Miami, AZ I've been seeing Dr. Reyes for a few years now and I have to say she is by far the best and my favorite dentist. Her team and herself are all very excellent at their jobs. After nerve damage from having my wisdom teeth removed in the military, my teeth have been very sensitive. She always remembers my pain points and I've never had to remind her or her team. They are extremely thoughtful and thorough. Overall, great team, great service and excellent five star dental care. Extremely recommended. Our general dentistry services focus on preventive treatments such as routine check-ups, professional cleanings, and digital X-rays to detect potential issues early. We also offer fluoride treatments and dental sealants to protect your teeth from decay. By maintaining consistent dental visits, you can prevent major oral health problems and enjoy a lifetime of strong, healthy teeth. Preventive Care Regular exams and cleanings help prevent cavities, gum disease, and other dental issues. Learn More Cosmetic Dentistry A healthy smile starts with regular dental care. We also offer fluoride treatments and dental sealants to protect your teeth from decay. Learn More Teeth Whitening Brighten your smile with professional whitening treatments that remove stains and discoloration. Porcelain Veneers Thin, custom-made shells that cover imperfections and create a flawless, natural-looking smile. Composite Bonding A quick and effective way to repair chips, cracks, or gaps using tooth-colored resin for a seamless look. Restorative Dentistry Damaged, decayed, or missing teeth can affect both your appearance and overall oral health. Our restorative dentistry services focus on rebuilding and strengthening your smile with treatments such as dental crowns, bridges, fillings, and implants. We use advanced technology and high-quality materials to ensure durable and natural-looking restorations. Whether you need a simple filling or full-mouth rehabilitation, we are dedicated to restoring your smile’s function and aesthetics. Learn More Orthodontics Crooked or misaligned teeth can lead to bite problems, difficulty chewing, and even jaw pain. Our orthodontic treatments, including traditional braces and Invisalign®, help align your teeth for improved function and aesthetics. Straight teeth are easier to clean, reducing the risk of cavities and gum disease. Whether you’re a teenager or an adult, our orthodontic solutions are tailored to your needs, giving you a confident and well-aligned smile. Learn More Emergency Dentistry Dental emergencies can be painful and stressful, requiring immediate care. We provide prompt and effective treatment for toothaches, broken or knocked-out teeth, infections, and other urgent dental issues. Our goal is to relieve your pain, address the underlying problem, and restore your oral health as quickly as possible. If you’re experiencing a dental emergency, don’t wait—contact us right away for fast and compassionate care. Learn More Tooth Pain Relief Immediate treatment to reduce discomfort and prevent further issues. Tooth Repair Fast and effective solutions to restore broken or damaged teeth.
